''See also: [[Karoshan queen (The Traveler's Gate Trilogy) Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The title of [[Queen]] of [[Damasca]] has been held by several notable women. The first queen was a legendary figure who unified the nation, defeated an [[Elysian Incarnation]] in combat, and established the connection between her bloodline and the territory of [[Ragnarus the Crimson Vault|Ragnarus]]. A later ruler, [[Cynara]], was known for her history during a period of continental destruction caused by [[Elysian Traveler|Elysian Travelers]]. In the current era, [[Leah]] serves as [[the Queen]] of [[Damasca]] and is also a [[Ragnarus Traveler]]. Despite her royal status, she faces political challenges regarding her [[Authority|authority]] following the revelation that her father is still alive. As [[Queen]], [[Leah]] feels a duty to protect [[Cana]] from the [[Ragnarus Incarnation]] and intends to command [[Damascan Travelers]] once the [[Incarnations]] are defeated.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The first [[Queen]] [[Cynara]] experienced intense rage when faced with the manipulations of the [[Elysian Incarnation]]. As the original [[Ragnarus Incarnation]], she held significant [[Authority|authority]] as [[the Queen]] of [[Damasca]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[Queen]] [[Cynara]] the First was enraged by the manipulation of the [[Elysian Incarnation]]. Additionally, she launched a red wooden javelin at [[Helgard]].}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[Queen]] [[Cynara]], also known as the First of her name, originally served as the [[Ragnarus Incarnation]] and ruled over [[Damasca]]. During her reign, she established an ancient pact concerning the permitted entrants of the [[Crimson Vault]]. After becoming enraged by the manipulations of the [[Elysian Incarnation]], she launched a red wooden javelin toward [[Helgard]]. Later, a second [[Queen]] [[Cynara]] successfully sealed the [[Avernus Incarnation]].}}
